title: Burnham brings in military and bans disposable barbecues in ‘tinderbox’ Britain

paragraphs.en: Downing Street has issued a temporary GB-wide ban on the sale of disposable barbecues and brought in the military to help deal with wildfires as Andy Burnham urged people not to risk lives in “tinderbox” Britain this weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 唐宁街已发布一项覆盖全英国范围的临时禁令，禁止销售一次性烧烤炉，并调集军方协助应对野火。安迪·伯纳姆敦促人们本周末不要在“犹如火药桶”的英国冒险拿生命当儿戏。

paragraphs.en: The prime minister spoke from Stourbridge in the West Midlands, where at least 19 people have been taken to hospital during eight fires that have ripped through several homes .
paragraphs.zh: 这位首相在西米德兰兹郡的斯陶尔布里奇发表讲话，当地在八起大火中已有多所房屋被烧毁，至少19人被送往医院。

paragraphs.en: He said it was necessary to bring in a temporary ban on disposable barbecues from today, asking retailers to withdraw them from sale, as he spoke of the “absolutely devastating” wildfires.
paragraphs.zh: 他在谈到这些“令人彻底心碎”的野火时表示，从今天起有必要临时禁止一次性烧烤炉的销售，并呼吁零售商将其下架。

paragraphs.en: “Please think about the situation we are in,” he said. “Britain is a tinderbox right now. Setting a fire in any outdoor setting is a risk to people’s homes and other people’s lives.”
paragraphs.zh: “请大家想一想我们目前所处的境况，”他说，“现在的英国就像个火药桶。在任何户外场所点火，都是在拿别人的家园和其他人的生命冒险。”

paragraphs.en: He said not all of the 37 fires across Britain had been caused by barbecues but it was “probable” that some of them had been.
paragraphs.zh: 他说，英国各地发生的37起火灾并非都是由烧烤炉引起的，但“有可能”其中一些确实与之相关。

paragraphs.en: Advice published online by the government said that single-use grills had “been the cause of a number of serious wildfires across the country over the summer months.
paragraphs.zh: 政府在网上发布的建议称，一次性烤炉“已在整个夏季成为全国多起严重野火的起因”。

paragraphs.en: “Disposable barbecues cannot be considered a safe product in the context of the ongoing weather and environmental conditions and must not be made available for sale either in store or online at the current time.”
paragraphs.zh: “在当前持续的天气和环境条件下，一次性烧烤炉不能被视为安全产品，现阶段无论在实体店还是网上都不得上架销售。”

paragraphs.en: The prime minister also revealed he planned to commission firefighting planes, as used to douse flames in Europe and the US, to combat the spread of wildfires, as he said the country had to “face up” to the “changing climate”.
paragraphs.zh: 这位首相还透露，他计划订购消防飞机——就像欧洲和美国用来扑灭火焰的那种——来对抗野火的蔓延。他说，英国必须“正视”“不断变化的气候”。
